'''Makoto Ishii''' (Japanese: '''石井真''' ''Ishii Makoto'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ishii was born on February 24, 1976, in {{wp|Chiba, Chiba|Chiba}}, {{wp|Chiba Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He occasionally lent his voice to the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|RS}} and {{aniseries|DP}}. Then, during {{aniseries|BW}}, he voiced his best-known role, which was [[Cress]], one of the three [[Striaton City]] [[Gym Leader]]s and brothers. Ishii is currently affiliated with Remax.
